```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

To use the CASTool a station ID code is required.

To aid in the selection of a station use the "Map, Stations" tab.

The map functions much like Google Earth (zoom in/out, pan, selection of elements, turn on/off layers, etc.).

Tool results will be compiled into a zip file for download.

The download button will not be active until the results are ready.
